instruction.text: Reread this paragraph and answer the question.

atoms.text: Musk oxen are large mammals who are related to mountain goats. The average adult musk ox can weigh between 200-350 kilograms. Musk oxen typically live between 12-20 years. They have large horns to fight predators and long, thick hair to protect them from the cold, difficult winters. In the spring, once the weather gets warmer, they begin to shed their winter hair. In the summer, they eat a lot in order to store fat so that they can survive the winter.

instruction.text: Reread this paragraph and answer the question.

atoms.text: Musk oxen are herbivores. Their favourite foods are roots, grass, moss and lichen. Their main predators are wolves and humans. To protect themselves against predators, musk oxen form a large circle with their calves in the middle. The adults face outwards towards the predators with their sharp horns. There was a time, when human hunters killed many musk oxen. Today, however, there are laws that protect these impressive animals.

instruction.text: Reread this paragraph and answer the question.

atoms.text: Musk oxen live in the tundra and like to live in herds of about 20-30 oxen. Their herds are led by female oxen. They live in Canada, Greenland, northern Russia and the high Arctic Islands. Every year in the fall, male musk oxen fight each other for the attention of female musk oxen and to have calves with them. Female musk oxen are pregnant for about 8 months and bear their calves in spring.
